run_func_dist: run a function across multiple processes with PyTorch distributed environment setup using a specified world size
enable_dist_context: enable a PyTorch distributed process group using the gloo backend within a context manager for testing
enable_dist_env_decorator: decorate a test function to automatically enable a single-process distributed data parallel environment
test_run_func_dist: test the run_func_dist function by passing a world size and a callable that accepts rank and arguments
review_enable_dist: review the enable_dist context manager to understand how it initializes and tears down a PyTorch distributed process group
